cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You beat me at chess. Take a photograph of the board.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you use your queen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I wanted to explore the rest of my team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you go easy on me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You found the finishing move. Let the photograph remember that.

mechanism: Copy removal of a spare chess piece as a competitive opening, then conceal the resulting handicap to protect the opponent's pride in winning.
confusable: Not an expert knowingly throwing a game: B2 must expose the mistaken imitation while A covers it with purported strategy.
comparison: One opponent offers a rematch; alternative b is a family competitor offering to share a prize.
seedUse: Retains unused queen and protection of a chess win; replaces unexplained withheld advantage with an explicit copied removal.
